components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The standard affirmative action for operational workflows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font: 600 14px/1 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--control-shadow); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / .9); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(15,23,42,.14); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.975); }

components.name: Gradient Button
components.description: A selective high-value action using the established brand gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-gradient { height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#39A9DB 0%,#8E14A8 100%); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(109,14,131,.15); transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-gradient:hover { filter: brightness(1.03); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(109,14,131,.2); } .ds-btn-gradient:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-gradient:active { transform: scale(.975); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A bounded secondary action for adjacent workflow choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--background) / .8); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--control-shadow); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--primary) / .3); background: hsl(var(--primary) / .06); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(.975); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The standard profile and operational data-entry field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 600 14px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--background) / .8); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--control-shadow); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground) / .35); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: hsl(var(--primary) / .6); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsl(var(--primary) / .2), var(--control-shadow); }

components.name: Default Card
components.description: The primary neutral container for forms, tools, and grouped information.
components.html:
Operational details

Personal information

Keep the details connected to your QC account accurate.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border) / .6); border-radius: 14px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--card-foreground)); box-shadow: var(--surface-shadow); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 400ms ease, transform 400ms ease; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card .ds-card-eyebrow { color: hsl(var(--primary)); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--primary) / .22); box-shadow: var(--surface-shadow-raised); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact role, category, or status label with softly tinted emphasis.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--primary) / .1); color: hsl(var(--primary)); font: 600 12px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-badge:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / .2); } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Branded Navigation
components.description: The compact QC identity bar used at the top of member and service-tool surfaces.
components.html: QCQuality Control UnitService toolsHome
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(165,243,252,.1); border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(110deg,rgba(2,12,32,.96),rgba(26,20,69,.95) 58%,rgba(74,20,96,.94)); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 18px 50px -24px rgba(2,6,23,.72); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-mark { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #07152f; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav-title { display: grid; margin-right: auto; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-nav-title strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-nav-title small { margin-top: 3px; color: rgba(207,250,254,.65); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: #fff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #67e8f9; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The Quality Control Unit interface presents serious operational work with calm clarity. Cool, pale surfaces keep information readable while the established cyan-to-purple identity supplies recognition, emphasis, and a measured sense of energy.

The system is compact, touch-friendly, and gently dimensional. Strong headings, short labels, precise rounded controls, and restrained surface lift help members scan responsibilities and complete forms without the interface feeling clinical. “Excellence is our culture” is expressed through order, legibility, and dependable states rather than decoration alone.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper-like backgrounds with white or translucent working surfaces.
Cyan primary actions and selective purple brand emphasis.
Bold, tightly tracked headings paired with highly legible Geist body text.
Rounded, tactile controls with restrained shadows and explicit focus states.
Mobile-first spacing that opens into centered, bounded desktop layouts.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Wallpaper Rule
rules.body: Cyan and purple identify actions, active states, and brand moments; routine content remains on neutral surfaces.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and danger colors communicate their actual state and are not used as interchangeable decoration.

rules.name: The Weight Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy through size, weight, and measured tracking; do not add decorative type treatments to routine product copy.

rules.name: The Bounded Workspace Rule
rules.body: Let the ambient page extend edge to edge, but keep navigation, reading, and forms inside a centered maximum-width workspace.

rules.name: The Mobile Sequence Rule
rules.body: Preserve the task's reading and action order when columns collapse; never rely on desktop position alone to explain hierarchy.

rules.name: The Restrained Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth clarifies containment and interaction; routine surfaces never float dramatically above the page.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Smaller elements inside a rounded surface use an equal or smaller radius so the visual nesting remains orderly.

dos: Do use neutral surfaces for sustained reading and reserve brand color for identity, state, and action.
Do maintain 44px minimum touch targets and visible keyboard focus across navigation and controls.
Do preserve the established 10px control and 14px surface corner rhythm.
Do provide opaque and reduced-motion behavior when the user's accessibility preferences request it.
Do use semantic colors with accompanying labels or icons where status meaning matters.
donts: Don't turn a surface-specific composition, including the profile's membership-passport presentation, into a mandatory global layout.
Don't cover routine forms or dense operational content in strong gradients.
Don't use large shadows, continuous floating motion, or decorative lift that competes with task completion.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels for sentences, body copy, or primary form instructions.
Don't rely on translucency, color, or a profile image as the sole carrier of meaning.
